entities.name: Query arylacetonitrilase
observations: 327 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 35.58 kDa and theoretical pI 5.28.
Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry V5IPE4 from Neurospora crassa, annotated as arylacetonitrilase.
Contains CN hydrolase Pfam domain PF00795.28 at residues 6–292.
Homolog annotations identify catalytic residues including a proton acceptor at position 45 and a nucleophile at position 167; an additional active-site residue is annotated at position 126.

entities.name: Nitrile hydrolysis
observations: General reaction: nitrile + 2 H2O → corresponding carboxylate + NH4(+).
Mapped as Rhea RHEA:21724 and associated with EC 3.5.5.1/3.5.5.5 annotations in reviewed homologs.

entities.name: Phenylacetonitrile hydrolysis
observations: Representative substrate-specific reaction: phenylacetonitrile + 2 H2O → phenylacetate + NH4(+).
Reviewed homologs preferentially hydrolyze phenylacetonitrile; some also accept mandelonitrile and related aryl nitriles.
A chlorinated analog is represented by Rhea RHEA:20657, but exact substrate breadth should not be assumed from this mapping alone.

entities.name: Query protein properties
observations: Sequence-derived molecular weight is 35581.901 Da; theoretical pI is 5.282; predicted charge at pH 7 is -10.73.
These are calculated values and do not account for modifications, oligomerization, or bound ligands.
